title: Mini Chicken Sashlics
description: Mini Chicken Sashlics are flavorful Continental-style grilled chicken skewers marinated in yogurt, herbs, and mustard, paired with colorful vegetables and finished with a buttery balsamic glaze. They make an elegant appetizer for parties and fine dining.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Marinade
items: Boneless chicken breast or thigh – 500 g, cut into 2 cm cubes

ingredients.title: For the Vegetables
items: Red bell pepper – 1, cut into 2 cm cubes
Yellow bell pepper – 1, cut into 2 cm cubes
Zucchini – 1, sliced into 1 cm thick rounds

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a stainless steel bowl, mix yogurt, olive oil, Dijon mustard, garlic paste, ginger paste, paprika, thyme, oregano, lemon juice, salt, and white pepper.
Add the chicken cubes and coat evenly with the marinade.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight for deeper flavor.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Skewers
steps: Thread the marinated chicken alternately with bell peppers, zucchini, and onion petals onto mini cocktail skewers.
Arrange the vegetables evenly for a colorful presentation.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Grill the Sashlics
steps: Heat a cast iron grill pan or charcoal grill over medium-high heat.
Grill the skewers for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally until the chicken is golden and fully cooked.
Baste lightly with butter during grilling.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Prepare the Glaze
steps: Melt the butter with olive oil in a small pan.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce and balsamic glaze.
Brush the glaze over the hot skewers before serving.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating
steps: Serve the mini sashlics upright in a shot glass or arrange them on a slate platter.
Drizzle the plate with micro-herb oil if desired.
Serve with a quenelle of garlic aioli or smoked paprika mayonnaise.
Garnish with microgreens or edible flowers.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot as an appetizer with garlic aioli or smoked paprika mayonnaise.
Pair with a fresh green salad or grilled vegetables.
Arrange on a slate platter for an elegant continental presentation.

chefTips: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum tenderness and flavor.
Use a charcoal grill for an authentic smoky taste.
Baste with butter during grilling to keep the chicken juicy.
Brush the glaze over the skewers just before serving for a glossy finish.
Alternate colorful vegetables for an attractive presentation.
